title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・キーワード①

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With strides sharp enough to crack open sea urchins, Gold Ship claims victory and receives the first clue from Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not long after, Gold Ship and Tosen Jordan find themselves embroiled in a fight over the last remaining dessert at lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their fates are so intertwined that the two once argued over how spicy chicken wing sauce should be (at least, according to Gold Ship's memory).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the general falsity of Gold Ship's claims, they're enough to incite yet another argument. Now, the two of them will settle things once and for all on the track!
